title: Openings for pipes.
officialText:
In or on structures where openings have been made in walls, floors or ceilings for the passage of pipes,
such openings shall be closed and protected in an approved manner.
SECTION PC 305
PROTECTION OF PIPES AND PLUMBING SYSTEM
COMPONENTS
